data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Who is Shakespeare's Shylock? ASSISTANT:

Shylock is a character in William Shakespeare’s play “The Merchant of Venice”. He is a Jewish moneylender who is the main antagonist of the play. In the play, Shylock is portrayed as a villain, however, he also has moments of compassion and his character helps to highlight the themes of justice and mercy in the play.
